skill.name: book-appointment-online
skill.description: Find providers with online booking and a free slot, fill in the booking form and stop before confirming. Use when someone wants an appointment (dentist, doctor, service) found and prepared.
skill.summary: Prepare an online appointment through MyClawn and stop before the user commits the booking.
skill.author: 20vision

security_audit.summary: The flagged URL is a task-description link, not an instruction to upload data or execute code. The skill requires user review before third-party submissions and stops before booking commitment. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unauthorized data transfer in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: Full description of this job, with the steps and the limits: https://www.myclawn.com/find-and-book-a

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:32 presents the MyClawn URL as a task-description reference with campaign tracking parameters. The text instructs no sensitive-data transfer or code execution, so the URL alone does not establish a security risk.

content.value_statement: Finding a provider with a suitable online appointment can require repeated searches and form entry. This skill delegates preparation to MyClawn and stops before booking commitment.
actual_capabilities: Draft a provider-search task using the requested location, provider type, and time window.
Delegate searches for online booking and available slots through the MyClawn Computer connector.
Prepare booking forms and stop before committing an appointment.
Show the task wording for user review before third-party submissions.
Report the connector result with a final-screen screenshot and recording link.
Leave website login and captcha steps to the user.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector and its task tool; this skill does not provide them.
Availability and progress depend on provider websites and their booking requirements.
The user must handle required logins and captchas; the skill does not create accounts.
The skill stops before booking commitment and cannot guarantee a confirmed appointment.

use_cases.title: Prepare a dental appointment
use_cases.description: Find a dentist near home with an online slot during a specified morning window, then prepare the booking for personal confirmation.

use_cases.title: Locate a nearby medical provider
use_cases.description: Search a new neighborhood for a doctor with online booking and a suitable slot, leaving final confirmation to the user.

use_cases.title: Arrange a service appointment
use_cases.description: Find a service provider with online booking during limited free hours and return the prepared booking screen for review.

prompt_templates.title: Find a provider
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a [provider type] in [location] with online booking during [time window]. Show me the task wording before sending it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: specify a provider, place, and preferred time.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a specific appointment
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a dentist in Vienna 1070 on a Tuesday morning within three weeks. Prepare the booking, but stop before commitment. Show the wording first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow the search to a district and recurring time preference.

prompt_templates.title: Limit the search to chosen sites
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [provider sites] for a [provider type] in [location] during [time window]. Show the task wording first. Prepare one suitable booking without committing it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: constrain the delegated task to selected provider websites.

prompt_templates.title: Specify review and handoff boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a MyClawn task for [provider], [area], and [dates]. Require review before submissions, user handling of login or captcha, and no booking commitment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: define approval boundaries and user handoffs before delegation.

output_examples.input: Find a dentist in Vienna 1070 on a Tuesday morning within three weeks. Show the task wording before sending.
output_examples.output: Proposed task: Find a dentist in Vienna 1070 with online booking on a Tuesday morning within three weeks. Prepare the booking and stop before commitment.

output_examples.input: What should the report say when a provider website requires me to log in?
output_examples.output: The provider website requires your login before preparation can continue. Please sign in on the live screen. No booking has been committed.

output_examples.input: Show an example completion report after the connector prepares a booking without committing it.
output: A suitable appointment is prepared for your review.
The booking has not been committed; you must confirm it yourself.

best_practices: Specify the provider type, location, acceptable dates, and preferred hours before delegation.
Review the task wording before authorizing any form submission or third-party write.
Inspect the final screen and appointment details before personally committing the booking.
anti_patterns: Treating a prepared booking screen as a confirmed appointment.
Asking the connector to bypass captcha checks, create accounts, or handle login without the user.
Authorizing third-party submissions without reviewing the task wording.

faq.question: What does this skill prepare?
faq.answer: It delegates provider searches and online appointment preparation to MyClawn, stopping before booking commitment.

faq.question: Does it work without MyClawn?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires the MyClawn Computer connector to be signed in and provide its task tool.

faq.question: Will it confirm my appointment automatically?
faq.answer: No. It stops before booking commitment, and you confirm the appointment in your own name.

faq.question: Who handles website logins and captchas?
faq.answer: You handle required logins and solve captchas on the live screen. The skill instructs the agent not to create accounts.

faq.question: What result should I receive?
faq.answer: The workflow asks the connector to return an answer, a screenshot of the final screen, and a screen-recording link.

faq.question: Can I change the provider and time window?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the example provider, location, and time window with your requirements, then review the task wording before submission.
